title: The Chess Algorithm: source code, experiment scripts and results
description: Source code, experiment scripts, raw results and manuscript sources accompanying the paper "The Chess Algorithm: A Novel Metaheuristic Optimization Technique with Applications in Transportation Network Engineering". Random seeds are fixed throughout, and every number reported in the paper corresponds to a committed output in this repository.
